Departure comparison

Best and lowest are sampled every 30 minutes within 10 hours of your selected departure. They compare the lowest available priority tide, not depth. Missing station predictions make a result unavailable.

Bridges and slow areas

Slow-speed assumptions: This first version uses an estimated 5 kt in the final 0.7 nm through the Shinnecock Canal. Its boundaries are approximate; other no-wake areas are not yet mapped. Vessel traffic and proximity-based restrictions can require additional slowing.

For bridge schedules and temporary changes, consult 33 CFR 117.799 and Coast Guard notices. Smith Point Bridge replacement construction is underway; verify present conditions.
